protocol.provenance: Synthetic journeys from journey-2.0. Zero measured training cases.
protocol.grouping: Both branches and every sampled time from one parameter draw remain together; exact predictive configurations are unique.
protocol.primary_metric: Mean absolute error over 8 outputs, both branches and 16 time points, with each trajectory equally weighted.
protocol.calibration: 90% split-conformal simultaneous envelope over all 8 outputs, both branches and sampled times per case. Exchangeability applies only to this synthetic in-domain sampling distribution.
protocol.selection: Choose family by original validation MAE after fixed postprocessing; freeze selection and calibration before opening fresh test.
protocol.ood: Low velocity [0.1,0.3) or high velocity (1.8,2.0], outside train support. Also reject any runtime parameter outside the trained support box.
protocol.budget: Each trained model gets the same minibatch size, optimizer steps and validation schedule; record parameter counts and wall time. No claim of equal FLOPs or quantum advantage.
protocol.scope: Learn simulator behavior and prioritize discriminating measurements. No clinical efficacy, MW-dependent HA biology, or automatic empirical identity of vesicles.
protocol.revision: The first test exposed cumulative-fate reversals. Its results are retired diagnostics. Fixed conservative postprocessing is evaluated on fresh calibration/test/OOD draws; no weight retraining.
protocol.constraint: Monotone cumulative uptake/clearance, bounded by available mass; proportional redistribution of remaining mass. Report raw violations and correction magnitude.
